observations.black_knights_fortress: The disguise is needed at the fortress entrance. Completion grants three quest points, coins and two separate 1,000 XP combat lamps in build 242.
observations.recruitment_drive: The testing grounds check the full modeled item list for empty inventory and equipment. The five randomly assigned tests are represented as one attempt. Use the supplied warhammer or bare hands for Sir Leye's final hit.
observations.the_lost_tribe: The guided tunnel shortcut opens after the first successful contact with Mistag. The treaty handover grants Mining XP and the ring of life.
observations.death_to_the_dorgeshuun: Two full H.A.M. outfits are needed before the infiltration. One outfit is handed to Zanik. Completion opens the city door, watermill routes and south dungeon fairy ring when the ring network is available.
observations.wanted: The Commorb may be bought or assembled. Either essence type can satisfy the handover. The pursuit includes three estimated variable-clue legs between the fixed Canifis, Champions' Guild, mine and rune essence visits.
observations.temple_of_the_eye: Credit 4,210 in-quest Runecraft XP by the end of the tutorial and the separately published 5,000 XP at completion. Persten and Herbert supply the quest teleports. The permanent portal and grouping teleport are gated on completion.
observations.a_porcine_of_interest: Spria provides goggles before the fight and awards 30 Slayer reward points on the last visit.
observations.daddys_home: Build 242 grants one quest point. Credit the aggregated 544 build XP at the bed stage and 400 XP on completion. Marlo gives a house or 1,000 GP according to ownership. Opening his crate is a separate action.
